Project T19-audited-purchase, repository `business` (scope repo.business).

Route/API/frontend/database conventions: not applicable to this snapshot — the selected source set contains only rules.md (documentation) and flow.ts (code); no router registry, HTTP/GraphQL registration, request wrapper, service or dataSource declaration exists in these two files. capabilities api/database/frontend/routes remain not_configured (per status coverage), so no identityDelta is registered.

Workflow evidence confirmed from current sources (generation 2, snapshot snap_294b38b3...):
1. rules.md declares a synthetic audited acceptance state machine with explicit transition lines `<FROM> -> <TO>: <trigger>, <guard>` (observed structure: regex-shaped lines DRAFT->SUBMITTED, SUBMITTED->APPROVED, SUBMITTED->DRAFT, APPROVED->RECEIVING, RECEIVING->COMPLETED, APPROVED->CANCELLED). Source: rules.md lines 7-12, hash 47228846...
2. rules.md declares an ordered document chain "purchase -> receipt -> return" with ordered keys tenant_id, purchase_no, line_no (line 13). Document-key vocabulary is declared, not observable in code.
3. rules.md declares UI page ordering /purchase/approve precedes /Other/purchaseLedger precedes /purchase/receive, and that /help is NOT a business successor (lines 14-15). No route registry exists in the snapshot to corroborate these pages, so they must stay declared-only.
4. rules.md explicitly forbids treating "logging before saving" as a transition and requires gap WORKFLOW_EVIDENCE_MISSING (line 17); flow.ts line 2 comment restates this ("calling audit before save is not a business transition"). Call order must never become transitions_to.
5. rules.md declares a conflict variant (line 18): a document allows finish at grossReceived >= orderedQty while code requires netReceived. Resolution rule: code wins for observed behaviour; the document divergence stays recorded as a declared conflict, not merged into one guard.
6. flow.ts implements the guards in code: submit requires orderedQty > 0 AND supplierId (line 3); approve requires actor.role === 'buyer' AND approvalGranted (line 8); receive requires sum of POSTED, non-deleted receipt qty > 0 (line 12); finish requires netReceived >= orderedQty AND allReceiptsValid (line 15); withdraw requires state === 'SUBMITTED' AND applicant === actor.id (line 18); cancel requires state === 'APPROVED' AND netReceived === 0 (line 21). These are observed declarations, basis=declared origin=static for the doc-derived states, and the code lines corroborate the same guard vocabulary.
